name: Illinois Culinary Equipment
old_description: PROFESSIONAL QUALITY, PROFESSIONAL GRADE FOR THE PROFESSIONAL YOU!
about:
Illinois Culinary Equipment (ICE) is based in Chicago, Illinois. The company was founded by Michael Palombo, a classically trained chef who spent 25 years in professional kitchens, including roles as executive chef at the Carolina Inn in Chapel Hill, the University Park Hotel at MIT, and the Mount Washington Hotel in New Hampshire. After a stint as a sales manager for RATIONAL Cooking Systems, Palombo launched ICE as a manufacturers' representative, initially partnering with Electrolux Professional before expanding to represent a full suite of commercial kitchen brands.

ICE does not manufacture equipment; instead, it provides commercial kitchen design, equipment specification, and project consulting for foodservice operators. The firm's staff assists with concept development, space planning, traffic patterns, maintenance considerations, and budget management. ICE represents several major manufacturers, including Norbec, Henny Penny, Rosati Bisani, Oscartek, Carpigiani, Electrolux Professional, and RATIONAL Cooking Systems, offering clients a single point of contact for a wide range of cooking, refrigeration, and preparation equipment.

The company serves restaurants, hotels, institutional cafeterias, and specialty foodservice concepts such as carry-out delis and cook-and-chill kitchens. Its client base includes independent operators and multi-unit chains seeking expertise in kitchen layout and equipment selection.

Palombo's culinary background is cited as a key differentiator: his firsthand kitchen experience informs the firm's approach to equipment selection and workflow design. ICE emphasizes personalized service and deep product knowledge to help clients avoid pitfalls and maximize efficiency.

name: Illinois Iron Inc. - Architectural Metals , Rails , Fences , Custom Fabrication
old_description: Custom Metal Fabrication for the Finest Commercial Environments
about:
Illinois Iron Inc. operates from Rockford, Illinois, where it was founded in 1998 as a modest welding operation. The company has grown over two decades into a recognized architectural metal fabricator serving the Midwest and beyond.

The shop specializes in custom architectural metalwork, producing precision-crafted railings, cladding, trim, stair components, countertops, bar fronts, wall cladding, screens, partitions, signage, and storefront elements. In-house capabilities include welding, powder coating, and a range of finish options such as patinas, brushed metals, and custom coatings, allowing end-to-end control from raw material to finished piece.

Its customer base includes architects, builders, designers, and millwork firms on commercial, hospitality, and public-space projects. Notable installations include the PNC Building in downtown Chicago for millwork partner Bernhard WoodWork, as well as restaurants, hotels, and retail storefronts across Illinois.

The company states its founding mission was to deliver precision-engineered metalwork that elevates architectural design while standing the test of time, rooted in honest communication, superior craftsmanship, and dedication to customer satisfaction. Expanded finish capabilities now enable full end-to-end solutions aligned with design intent.

about:
Illinois Solar is based in Moline, Illinois, and serves residential and commercial customers across Northwest Illinois, North Central Illinois, and the greater Quad Cities area. The company specializes in solar energy system design and installation, along with complementary services such as battery backup storage, electric vehicle charger installation, and solar panel cleaning and snow removal.

Its service portfolio covers custom solar panel design and installation, backup battery storage systems that store excess solar energy for use during outages, EV charging station installation for homes and businesses, and ongoing maintenance including panel cleaning and snow removal to maintain peak production. The company handles projects from initial planning through installation and long-term support.

Illinois Solar works with homeowners and business owners seeking to reduce electricity costs and increase energy independence. Its customer base spans residential properties and commercial facilities throughout its service territory in western Illinois.

The company emphasizes experienced installation crews, quality equipment, and personalized service as its differentiators, aiming to deliver dependable solar solutions tailored to each property's energy needs and goals.

name: Illinois Supply Company
old_description: Illinois Supply Company was founded with the creation of the Original Allergy Emergency Kit that is now in thousands of schools around the world.
about:
Illinois Supply Company operates from Mokena, Illinois, and was founded with the creation of the Original Allergy Emergency Kit, a product now deployed in thousands of schools worldwide. The company is owned by Brandon Wilson, who also designed the original Overdose Emergency Kit that established the Naloxone Box category in 2014.

The company manufactures a range of emergency medical and harm reduction equipment, including naloxone cabinets, boxes, vending machines (such as the Barney freestanding kiosk), overdose emergency cabinets, and police pouches. It also produces epinephrine storage cabinets, Allergy Emergency Kits (AEK), school nurse storage panels, LiveSafer safety stations, AED cabinets, and bleeding control, asthma, and choking response kits. In 2024, the firm tripled its manufacturing and warehouse space to meet growing demand, and it emphasizes made-to-order production with ship-on-demand fulfillment for grant-funded programs.

Illinois Supply Company serves non-profit agencies, community health departments, school districts, correctional facilities, law enforcement, and state and county public health departments. Concrete clients include the Florida Department of Children and Family Services (203 drop-off locations, 1,880 kiosks and cabinets), Monroe County, New York (550 naloxone boxes), the California prison system, and numerous county health departments across New York, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Illinois, and other states.

The business originated to address allergy emergencies in schools and later expanded into overdose harm reduction. Wilson states that the company invests heavily in capacity, develops new products monthly based on customer requests, and offers custom product design. It operates a website dedicated to non-profit agencies that does not charge sales tax and maintains government registrations (CAGE/UEI) for public procurement.

name: Illinois Switchboard Corporation
old_description: was established in 1971 and has been providing outstanding electrical metering and distribution equipment ever since.
about:
Illinois Switchboard Corporation was established in 1971 in Addison, Illinois. The company has operated continuously since its founding, focusing on electrical metering and distribution equipment.

The company manufactures and designs electrical switchboards (up to 4000 amp), power and lighting panelboards, industrial control panels, and electrical enclosures with welded steel construction. It also produces special sheetmetal fabrications and specializes in alterations and additions to existing switchboards, including bus details and circuit breaker retrofits for any brand. A quick-ship program offers NEMA 1 distribution panels in 60-, 75-, and 90-inch heights, with main lug ratings from 400 to 1200 amps and main breaker ratings from 400 to 800 amps. The firm stocks a large selection of Siemens circuit breakers, fusible switches, and components, and says it can handle orders ranging from one to 1,000 pieces.

Illinois Switchboard serves customers needing electrical distribution and control equipment, including contractors, original equipment manufacturers, and facility operators who require modifications to installed gear. Its engineering staff assists with design and retrofit questions.

The company differentiates itself by offering rapid turnaround on stocked distribution panels, the ability to modify existing switchboards from any manufacturer, and an inventory of Siemens components that supports quick delivery.

name: Ilumen Solar
old_description: Specializing in High Quality and Highly Aesthetic Solar Installs
about:
Ilumen Solar is a locally owned solar installation company based in Lake Barrington, Illinois, serving the northwest Chicago suburbs. Founded in 2016 by Zach Witt, a Barrington native and NABCEP-certified Technical Sales Professional, the business began with a community-first mindset: “if we don’t start a solar business here then we’d be doing a disservice to the community.” Witt, a Montana State University graduate, also serves on the Barrington Area Chamber of Commerce board and mentors high school business students.

The company provides turnkey solar solutions for residential and commercial customers, including rooftop panel installation, battery backup, critter guards, electrical upgrades, EV charging, combined solar-and-roofing projects, inverter monitoring, and SREC management. A three-person core team—Witt, operations manager Dan, and project coordinator Austin—handles site assessment, design, procurement, and post-installation monitoring. Drone flights are conducted before proposals to ensure accurate production estimates.

Ilumen Solar works with homeowners, business owners, and “stranded” solar customers left without support from original installers. Reviews cite projects ranging from shaded residential properties requiring creative outbuilding mounting to commercial arrays, though specific client names are not disclosed. The firm also assists with Illinois incentive applications such as Illinois Shines.

Witt started the company to bring high-quality, aesthetically focused solar to the area. Differentiators include pre-contract site visits with drone surveys, meticulous design that hides conduit in attics, a preference for North American-sourced equipment, and financing without hidden dealer fees. The company emphasizes local presence, community involvement, and long-term service for systems built to last 25-plus years.

about:
Imagination Fabrication, LLC was established in 2009 by Nick Spring in Apex, North Carolina. The company began as a provider of metal fabrication, installation, and commercial truck repair services for customers throughout the Raleigh–Durham metro area, including Apex, Cary, Durham, Raleigh, Holly Springs, Garner, and surrounding communities.

The shop offers custom welding, metal fabrication, CNC plasma cutting, equipment repair, and wheel repair, with mobile welding services that bring equipment to the job site. Capabilities extend to entrance gate construction, dumpster door fabrication, restaurant equipment fabrication and repair, custom bumper and rack building, frame and roll‑cage work, and fuel tank fabrication and repair. The company also stocks a range of metal supplies for contractors and DIYers.

Clients include commercial truck operators needing diesel repairs, restaurants requiring custom equipment, property owners seeking gates and railings, and contractors sourcing metal materials. Projects have ranged from custom art pieces to structural roll cages and fuel tanks, serving the construction, transportation, food‑service, and residential markets in central North Carolina.

The company emphasizes the technical knowledge and hands‑on experience of its associates, combined with a specialization in aluminum and the ability to work with steel, brass, cast iron, stainless steel, and titanium. Mobile welding and a stocked metal supply yard are cited as key differentiators for customers who need on‑site service or materials for their own projects.

name: Impact Solar LLC
old_description: “From Start to Finish, the Entire Process Was Professional, Transparent, and Remarkably Efficient.”
about:
Impact Solar LLC is based in Haddonfield, New Jersey. The company was founded by Rob Warren, who, after observing the practices of other solar providers, set out to offer a transparent, no-pressure approach to solar adoption. The firm has served the community for over 11 years, operating across more than a dozen New Jersey counties.

The company designs and installs custom solar photovoltaic systems for residential and commercial properties, including battery backup storage and electric-vehicle charging stations. It also provides ongoing service, maintenance, and repair for existing solar arrays — even those originally installed by other contractors — covering inverter diagnostics, production monitoring, wiring repairs, and electrical service upgrades. All installations use U.S.-made equipment.

Impact Solar works with homeowners and businesses throughout New Jersey, with specific project experience in towns such as Haddonfield, Moorestown, and across Atlantic, Bergen, Burlington, Camden, and other counties. Its customer base includes both new solar adopters and system owners seeking reliable long-term support.

Warren started the business to eliminate pushy sales tactics and provide honest guidance, clear upfront quotes, and a hands-on local team that remains involved long after installation. The company highlights its NABCEP-certified leadership and commitment to U.S.-made components as key differentiators.

name: ImpactPro Parts Inc
old_description: is an aftermarket auto part distributor that has been serving the DMV for
about:
ImpactPro Parts Inc operates from Hyattsville, Maryland. The business began as a small warehouse in Beltsville, Maryland, before relocating to its current Hyattsville facility in 2001. A management change in 2018 brought process upgrades and an expanded delivery network reaching the Baltimore area.

The company distributes aftermarket collision parts and body shop supplies to auto repair shops across the DMV region. Its inventory spans domestic and foreign vehicle collision parts—including fenders, bumpers, headlamps, radiators, and structural components—as well as body shop materials such as clear coats, primers, adhesion promoters, body fillers, sandpaper, and dent pullers. The firm also stocks a selection of tools and continues to add products based on availability and demand.

Customers include independent body shops and collision repair centers throughout Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia, with recent delivery expansion into Baltimore. The company notes a culturally diverse clientele, supported by a fully bilingual (Spanish-English) female customer service team that has helped grow its Hispanic customer base.

ImpactPro Parts emphasizes exact-fit parts availability, competitive pricing, and timely delivery as its core differentiators. The company cites its diverse workforce and bilingual staff as drivers of innovation and adaptability, aiming to streamline the parts procurement process for shops completing auto body projects.
